description: This file implements a threading management library with classes for controlling individual threads and managing multiple threads, including creation, starting, stopping, and joining threads.

classes.name: _threadControlUnit
classes.description: Represents a controllable thread with support for one-time and looping execution, including start, stop, and thread object management.

classes.name: simpleThreadManager
classes.description: Manages multiple _threadControlUnit instances, providing methods to create, start, stop, and join threads by ID.

methods.name: createOneTimeThread
methods.description: Creates a thread that runs a function once.

methods.name: createLoopThread
methods.description: Creates a thread that runs a function repeatedly in a loop.

methods.name: stopLoopThreadWithID
methods.description: Stops a looping thread given its ID.

methods.name: startThreadWithID
methods.description: Starts a thread (either one-time or loop) given its ID.

methods.name: joinOneTimeThreadWithID
methods.description: Joins (waits for completion of) a one-time thread given its ID.
